title: Pasting the three representative tensor squares
statement: Fix ℓ, E and W and a coefficient reduction record R. If R satisfies its reduction tensor normalization, finite scalar tensor normalization, and evaluation tensor normalization, then it satisfies CoefficientReductionTensorEvaluation. This is a relation among the three already specified maps, with no existence or construction of tensor comparisons.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; representative tensor comparison and localization

proof.text: Restrict the two natural transformations to flat-term K-flat integral pairs, a faithful restriction by cochain tensor model rigidity.

Evaluate the strict reduction tensor square. Use evaluation/localization naturality and the evaluation tensor square, then move the three finite presentation identifications through the finite tensor model by naturality. Substitute the strict finite-component equation and the finite scalar tensor square. Cancel all representative isomorphisms and descend by faithfulness.
